rootCause: execute() delegatecalls into a caller-supplied implementation with no allowlist. A contract that mirrors the vault's storage layout can read the vault's ETH and rewrite the vault's balances mapping, giving the attacker the entire balance.

steps.title: Victim funds the vault
steps.description: The victim deposits 50 ETH; the vault credits balances[victim] and holds the ETH.

steps.title: Attacker supplies a malicious implementation
steps.description: execute() delegatecalls into any address the caller names. Nothing checks the implementation against an allowlist or verifies that the vault owner approved it.

steps.title: drain() executes in the vault's context
steps.description: Under delegatecall address(this) is the vault, so drain() reads the vault's 50 ETH balance, writes balances[attacker] in the vault's storage and force-sends the funds to the attacker.
